title: Callsmith Provider Pack
description: Each provider declares its real audio/transport/lifecycle contract plus known potholes. The resolver reconciles these across the selected stack to produce the compatibility matrix and audio bridge contract. This file documents the shape every providers/*/<id>.json must follow.

id.description: Stable identifier, matches menu option id. Lowercase-kebab.

directions.description: Which call directions this provider supports. Used for surface/direction impossibility detection (telephony only). Inert for kind: vad — VADs have no call-direction semantics; declare ["inbound","outbound"] as a safe superset.

native_capabilities.description: Native capabilities that short-circuit the resolver (e.g. audio_normalization absorbs the decode/resample bridge).

native_capability_conflicts.description: Reserved guard. Optional explicit conflicts between this pack's native capabilities and capabilities claimed by other selected packs. No installed pack currently declares a conflict; this field exists so a future SIP-direct carrier (or similar incompatibility) can refuse an incompatible stack at forge time. The shape is exercised by test/impossibility.test.mjs.

ingest.description: The audio format this component needs to RECEIVE on its input side (what the bridge must hand it).

egress.description: The audio format this component PRODUCES on its output side (what the bridge receives from it).

model.description: Current verified model ID. Pinned by staleness guard tests.

verification.description: Provenance for the factual claims in this pack. Refresh before expires_at; a URL merely being syntactically valid is not evidence that a claim is current.

grade.description: Strength of the evidence used for this pack.

verified_at.description: UTC calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the sources were checked.

expires_at.description: UTC calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which verification fails until the pack is refreshed.

sources.description: Primary evidence URLs supporting the pack's current factual claims.

streaming.description: Whether this provider supports streaming output.

tool_calling.description: Whether this provider supports function/tool calling.

context_window.description: Maximum context window in tokens (LLM only).

latency_estimates.description: Planning-only latency inputs in milliseconds, retained for compatibility with the resolver. These are not measurements and MUST have matching latency_evidence entries.

ttfa_ms.description: TTS: time to first audio chunk.

response_start_ms.description: Realtime model: time to first audio response.

latency_evidence.description: Evidence for each latency metric. Planning estimates explicitly carry a zero sample and unavailable percentiles; measured or vendor-reported distributions carry sample size, region, and p50/p95/p99.

region.description: Measurement region, or 'not_measured' for a planning estimate.

sample_size.description: Number of observed turns; zero only for planning estimates.

planning_value_ms.description: Architecture-budget input; required for planning_estimate and never represented as an observed percentile.

interruption.description: How this provider participates in barge-in / interruption handling.

mechanism.description: The interruption mechanism this provider uses.

description.description: What happens when the user interrupts.

lifecycle.description: Session/call lifecycle events this provider emits or expects.

mitigated_by.description: Native capabilities that, when present in any selected pack, downgrade this pothole to 'mitigated'. Used to separate 'still required in user code' from 'resolved by a native layer'.

cost_estimates.description: Architecture-planning cost inputs, never a quote or billing source. per_minute_usd is normalized for comparison; verify current account/region pricing before an SLO or purchase decision.

rate_usd.description: Raw rate in the billing unit.

per_minute_usd.description: Normalized cost per minute (USD). Pre-computed from billing + rate using conversational assumptions.
